scope: Exploratory numerical bare-plate thermal-proxy sensitivity to transverse corridor width. This is not an experimental validation, NIST comparison, or P5 qualification.

caseProvenance.beamMapping: NIST reports a measured nominal 67 um Gaussian Dg diameter with 5.2% combined standard uncertainty, but no downloadable raw 2D irradiance artifact. The solver input beamDiameter_um=67 is an ideal-Gaussian 1/e2 screening proxy; mapping it to the Table 4 nominal D4sigma value is conditional and not source-byte-bound.

fixedInputProvenance.sourcePenetration_um: 40 µm retained from the immediately preceding bounded bare-plate benchmark setup; this value is not supplied by NIST Table 4.
fixedInputProvenance.otherInputs: Unchanged from the validated 1 mm reference-run setup except for the requested Table 4 power, speed, nominal beam input, 10 mm track, and the three corridor widths.

baseline.input: 1 mm, 20 µm mesh, default 480 µm corridor, 80 W, 1200 mm/s, 80 µm beam input, 40 µm source penetration, maxDt 2e-7 s

wallTimeEstimateMethod.formula: baseline elapsed multiplied by (planned cells × resource_estimate minimumEstimatedSteps) / baseline cellSteps
wallTimeEstimateMethod.limitations: This simple cell-step scaling is not calibrated. It assumes similar per-cell update cost and is not a wall-time guarantee. Source limiting can increase step counts; the reference worker timeout is 300 s per job.

preregisteredObservationPlan.scope: Each output represents one simulated +X line at that x-location; it is not three line repeats or six experimental sections.
requiredOutputsIfRun: solver id/revision, resolved settings and input hash
requested and effective corridor width, mesh shape and cell count
accepted solver steps, elapsed wall time, minimum captured source fraction and source retries
energy input/loss/stored terms and relative closure error
separate section records with interpolation operator, source planes, width/depth thermal proxies and unsupported reason if any
preregisteredObservationPlan.comparisonResiduals: prohibited for this exploratory sensitivity report

costGateDecision.decision: Do not start the three 10 mm CPU solves. Estimates are about 5.5×, 8.1× and 10.7× the per-job timeout, even before any source-limited timestep increase.
costGateDecision.sectionResults: not-produced; no 10 mm solve was started
costGateDecision.sourceCaptureAndEnergy: not-measured; no 10 mm solve was started
costGateDecision.cheaperAlternative: A future three-width 1 mm run can cheaply smoke-test that the parameter changes the thermal field, but its 4.9/6.0 mm section records are unsupported and it cannot replace this requested 10 mm sensitivity. For the requested section evidence, first reduce reference-solver cost or provide a verified accelerated backend, then rerun this frozen protocol.
